column1: # Inventory of the tools image: one row per fact printed by tools-test/unpriv.sh, priv.sh and guest.sh, judged by
# packages     comma separated packages of guest/tools.pkgs or guest/dev.pkgs the row exercises; `-` for a fact
#              about a session, the host or the guest kernel that no package provides
# expectation  ok (the value is `ok` or starts with `ok `) | =VALUE | ver:PKG (contains the locked version of PKG,
#              from guest/{dev,tools,kernel}.lock) | ~REGEX (re.search) | deny:REGEX (a privileged-only operation the
#              unprivileged session must be refused: the value is `denied:` plus a message that matches REGEX)
# The expectation is the whole truth: a row whose value does not meet it is a FAIL unless tools-test/limits.tsv
# names why (a limit of the host hardware, kernel or configuration, or a known upstream defect), with the facts that
# prove the cause, a row that shows the tool working where the limit does not apply, and what the host must provide.
# What each capability needs (nothing, the real root, or something of the host) is in tools-test/capabilities.tsv.
# Every package of guest/tools.pkgs must appear in at least one row.
